syntax_clues_detected: f68r3.1 is @Cc: very long text 'odeed.oteedy.cheoteey...okeeaiin' — written around the OUTER circumference ring of the large central circle; this is the outer ring inscription
f68r3.2 through f68r3.9 are ALL @Ri (Radial inscriptions): text written along radial lines or spokes within the circular diagram, each reading outward from center
f68r3.10 and f68r3.11 are @Ls (isolated star labels): label individual stars within or near the circle
f68r3.12 is @La: a general area label (not star-specific, not central circle) — positioned in a specific zone of the diagram
f68r3.14 is =Ls (continuation of a label sequence), f68r3.15 is @Ls (new label), f68r3.16 is +Ls, f68r3.17 is +Ls — a multi-line label group: a star with a 3-part label entry (f68r3.15/16/17)
f68r3.18 is @Ls, f68r3.19 is +Ls, f68r3.20 is =Ls, f68r3.21 is *Ls — another multi-line label group spanning 4 lines, indicating a star with an extended label
f68r3.22 is @Cc: 'otcheody.chokchy.okol.cheal.dar.cho.keol.dolaiin.okeol.oly' — a SECOND @Cc inscription, written around a second circle (the inner circle or the central face circle)
visual_anchor_inventory: large_outer_circle: the main large circular boundary of the diagram, encompassing nearly the full page; the @Cc text (f68r3.1) runs along its inner rim
central_sun_face: a small circular medallion at the geometric center of the large circle, containing a human face; the second @Cc (f68r3.22) encircles this
radial_spokes: lines or text bands radiating from the center outward toward the circumference, dividing the circle into sectors; each @Ri label runs along one spoke
inner_star_field: dense field of individual gold/tan star drawings filling the interior of the large circle between the radial spokes
outer_star_ring: stars positioned along the outer band near the circumference of the large circle
left_margin_annotation_zone: a zone to the left of the main circle containing @Ls and @La labels for stars that extend slightly outside or near the circle's left edge

large_outer_circle.description: The primary structural element of f68r3. A large near-full-page circle drawn in brown ink, encompassing the entire star diagram. The outer circumference carries the long @Cc inscription (f68r3.1) running around its inner rim. The circle's diameter occupies approximately 85% of the page width and 85% of the page height.

central_sun_face.description: A small circular medallion at the exact geometric center of the large circle. Contains a rendered human face (eyes, nose, mouth) in brown ink, similar in style to f68r1's sun face but smaller and simpler. The second @Cc inscription (f68r3.22) wraps around this inner circle.

radial_spokes.description: Eight radial text bands or lines extending from near the central face outward toward the circumference, dividing the circle into sectors like pie slices. Each @Ri locus (f68r3.2–f68r3.9) is written along one spoke. The spokes are visible as text-bearing channels between the star clusters.

inner_star_field.description: A dense field of individual 6–8 pointed gold/tan star drawings filling the interior space of the large circle, distributed between the radial spoke zones. Stars vary slightly in size. Each star in labeled zones has associated @Ls text.

left_margin_annotation_zone.description: An area to the left of the main circle's visual center containing @La and @Ls label groups (f68r3.10–f68r3.21). These labels correspond to stars that are either near the left boundary of the circle or in a specific labeled sector. Some multi-line label groups (f68r3.15/16/17 and f68r3.18/19/20/21) are clustered here.

text_blocks_mapping.description: The primary @Cc inscription (f68r3.1) — an extremely long single text line written around the inside of the large outer circle's circumference. This is the longest single locus in the three folios, containing approximately 35+ glyph-words. The text runs continuously around the circular rim, likely clockwise.

lines.interaction: Circular inscription following the inner rim of the large outer circle. The text begins at an indeterminate point on the circle (likely top or top-right) and runs continuously clockwise for the full circumference. The 35 glyph-words are evenly distributed around the ~2700-normalized-unit circumference arc. Individual word positions track with the circle: top arc words at y:45–120, right arc words at x:900–970, bottom arc words at y:900–980, left arc words at x:55–130. The text never enters the circle's interior — it is strictly a rim annotation.

text_blocks_mapping.description: Eight @Ri (radial) text lines, each written along one of the radial spokes dividing the circle's interior into sectors. @Ri text reads outward from the central face toward the circumference. Each spoke contains one @Ri locus with 4–5 glyph-words. The spokes divide the circle into 8 sectors of approximately 45 degrees each.

lines.interaction: Radial inscription on the NORTH spoke (top, approximately 12 o'clock). Text reads from center (y:420, x:480) northward toward the top circumference (y:80). Words are stacked or angled along the vertical axis of this spoke sector, between star clusters above the central face.
Radial inscription on the NE spoke (approximately 1:30–2 o'clock). Text angles from center upper-right toward the NE circumference arc.
Radial inscription on the EAST spoke (approximately 3 o'clock). Text runs horizontally left-to-right from center to the right circumference boundary.
Radial inscription on the SE spoke (approximately 4:30–5 o'clock). Text angles from center toward the SE arc.
Radial inscription on the SOUTH spoke (approximately 6 o'clock). Text runs from center downward toward the bottom circumference.
Radial inscription on the SW spoke (approximately 7:30–8 o'clock). Text angles from center toward the SW arc.
Radial inscription on the WEST spoke (approximately 9 o'clock). Text runs right-to-left from center leftward toward the left circumference.
Radial inscription on the NW spoke (approximately 10:30–11 o'clock). Text angles from center toward the NW arc.

text_blocks_mapping.description: A cluster of @Ls (star labels), @La (area label), and multi-line label groups positioned in the left-interior zone of the circle and the left margin area. Includes two extended multi-line label groups: f68r3.15–17 (a 3-line @Ls entry) and f68r3.18–21 (a 4-line @Ls entry), indicating stars with longer descriptive labels.

lines.interaction: Isolated star label in the left-interior zone of the circle. Labels a star to its right at approximately x:100–130.
Short isolated star label below f68r3.10, labeling a star in the left zone.

Area label (@La) — labels a broader zone or cluster of stars rather than a single star. Positioned in the left interior sector. This is the only @La in this folio, indicating a named region of the star field rather than a single celestial body.
Short isolated star label in the left zone.
Continuation label (=Ls) — part of the same label sequence as f68r3.13. Two-part label for one star: 'okos' + 'otory'.
Opening line of a 3-line star label group (@Ls). The star being labeled is nearby in the left interior zone.
Second line of the 3-line label group (+Ls). Continuation of the label for the same star. The comma in 'e,cphy' is a transcription variant marker.
Third line of the 3-line label group (+Ls). Final component of the multi-line label for this star.
Opening line of a 4-line star label group (@Ls). This is a notably extended label, suggesting a more prominent or specifically described star.
Second line of the 4-line label group (+Ls).
Third line of the 4-line label group (=Ls — alternate continuation marker).
Fourth and final line of the extended label group (*Ls — end marker). Completes the 4-part label 'o,cthyd / otydg / darall / okchody' for the same star.

text_blocks_mapping.description: The second @Cc inscription (f68r3.22), written around the inner central sun-face medallion. A shorter circular inscription of 10 glyph-words following the perimeter of the small central circle.

lines.interaction: Circular inscription around the central sun-face medallion. The 10 glyph-words follow the perimeter of the small face circle (bounding_box x:380–570, y:420–580). Text runs clockwise around the face, with dot-separated words spaced evenly across the ~600-unit circumference of this inner circle. The face drawing inside (eyes, nose, mouth) remains text-free.

isolated_zones.description: The large circle's exterior (outside the circumference line) is completely text-free. All text is contained within or on the circle. The outer @Cc inscription runs along the rim, and all @Ri, @Ls, and @La labels are interior.

isolated_zones.status: Encircled by second @Cc inscription / Face interior text-free
isolated_zones.description: The small central face medallion's interior (the actual face drawing) is text-free. The @Cc inscription f68r3.22 runs around its perimeter ring. The face sits at the convergence point of all 8 radial spokes.

isolated_zones.status: Text-bearing channels / Stars flanking each spoke
isolated_zones.description: Each of the 8 radial spokes carries one @Ri inscription. The stars of the inner field cluster in the sectors between spokes, leaving the spoke lines as text-defined paths. The @Ri text essentially functions as sector dividers, labeling each octant of the circle.

isolated_zones.status: Stars labeled by @Ls and @La / Star bodies text-free
isolated_zones.description: Individual star drawings within the circle are text-free. Their labels (@Ls) are placed adjacent, not on top of, each star. The multi-line label groups (f68r3.15–17 and f68r3.18–21) in the left zone indicate that some stars in that sector have notably more complex identifications.
